title: Malicious code in @camera.ui/camera-ui-nvr-windows-amd64 (npm)
description: The npm package @camera.ui/camera-ui-nvr-windows-amd64 version 1.6.1 contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
